articles.title: Can governments quickly and cheaply slow AI training?

curriculum.summary: This article discusses the feasibility of slowing down AI training through inference verification, assuming knowledge of AI development and safety concerns. articles.title: How to Design Environments for Understanding Model Motives

curriculum.summary: This article explains the importance of understanding model motives in AI safety, particularly in distinguishing between benign and malign motivations.
